title: R6I mini-bucket bounded-approximation gate
rigor_tier: exploratory bounded approximation with exact primitive validation

program_alignment.central_question: Can a user-controlled cluster cap yield a useful D4 posterior approximation before exact paper-L2 inference becomes structurally prohibitive?
program_alignment.epistemic_role: lowest-cost approximation prerequisite after R6H mapped the exact cutset time-space frontier
program_alignment.downstream_gate: GBP or tensor implementations are justified only if this explicit i-bound baseline leaves a measurable accuracy/cost gap

research_basis.source: Dechter and Rish, Mini-buckets: A general scheme for bounded inference, JACM 50 (2003), DOI 10.1145/636865.636866
research_basis.role: mini-bucket partitions bound created dependency dimension, giving a parameterized accuracy/complexity trade and probability-of-evidence bounds

research_basis.source: Rollon and Dechter, New Mini-Bucket Partitioning Heuristics for Bounding the Probability of Evidence, AAAI 2010
research_basis.role: partition heuristic materially affects bound quality, so representation and order sensitivity must be reported rather than hidden

question.smallest_claim: Primitive posterior pseudo-marginal error and evidence-bound tightness as functions of a registered maximum mini-bucket scope, plus paper-L2 structural and cross-representation diagnostics.
question.H1: increasing i-bound reduces primitive evidence-bound looseness and physical pseudo-marginal error
question.H2: when i-bound reaches the exact registered maximum cluster, mini-bucket reproduces exact bucket evidence and marginals within 1e-10
question.H3: paper-L2 bounds remain representation/order sensitive at i<=20, demonstrating that a bounded result is not yet a representation-invariant posterior approximation
question.falsification: failure of analytic controls, violation of the nonnegative evidence upper bound beyond 1e-10, or failure of the exact-ceiling control rejects implementation

model.algorithm: sum-product bucket elimination with each bucket greedily partitioned into mini-buckets whose union scope has at most i variables; factors sorted by decreasing scope and placed by minimum resulting union, then stable index
model.evidence: product-of-sums mini-bucket result, an upper bound for the nonnegative factor graph
model.pseudo_marginal: normalize separate clamped mini-bucket evidence bounds for X_e=0 and X_e=1; explicitly not a posterior bound
model.exact_invariant: both exact-preserving R6D representations have the same auxiliary-prior-adjusted exact evidence

primitive_metrics: maximum and mean absolute physical pseudo-marginal error
matrix.independent_unit: deterministic graph/order/i-bound row; no Monte Carlo samples
matrix.budget: under ten CPU minutes and 2 GiB; no correction, LER, threshold, runtime-scaling, or fault-tolerance samples

analysis.sensitivity: report every representation/order branch; do not select one post hoc
analysis.stop_rule: if exact-ceiling controls pass, report the complete finite matrix; if low-i errors or paper branch disagreement remain material, route the next gate to a richer approximation rather than expanding LER sampling
analysis.claim_boundary: No guarantee that normalized clamped upper bounds bound true marginals; no paper-L2 accuracy claim without an exact reference; no scalable decoder or logical-performance claim.

acceptance_items.evidence: scripts/d4_elimination_width.py and scripts/test_d4_elimination_width.py; 4 focused tests pass

acceptance_items.item: analysis, report, roadmap, metadata, and durable state

hypothesis_outcomes.H1: mixed: evidence bounds tighten monotonically in all four branches, but maximum marginal error is nonmonotone for superfactor/global (0.090 at i=10 to 0.126 at i=14)
hypothesis_outcomes.H2: supported on all seven exact-ceiling rows; maximum evidence-ratio error 1.998e-15 and maximum marginal error 1.110e-16
hypothesis_outcomes.H3: supported: paper-L2 cross-branch log10 spread remains 6.623 decades at i=20
